about.title: Who am I?
about.intro: Currently, I am a <current>Full Stack Developer</current> building fast, scalable web experiences driven by <aspiring>performance and purpose</aspiring>.
highlights: I graduated from HCMUNRE, a university that is not particularly strong in IT, so most of my programming knowledge comes from self-learning and building things in practice.
I always strive to learn and improve through each project, and I care as much about performance, scalability and cost efficiency as I do about shipping features.
My colleagues appreciate my teamwork — I can balance humour with productivity while making sure my work lands on time. I host internal sharing sessions and mentor junior developers.
I adopt AI tools in day-to-day development and team workflows to shorten delivery cycles and improve code quality, and I keep exploring how they can be applied to the product itself.

overview.title: TECHNICAL PROFILE
items: 5+ years building and scaling SaaS products end to end — owning features from concept through high-availability production deployments used by millions of people.
Deep expertise across modern frontend ecosystems: React, Next.js (App Router, Server Components), Gatsby, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Material UI.
Architected micro-frontend architectures using Webpack Module Federation — enabling independent team deployments at scale.
Craft pixel-perfect, responsive, cross-browser interfaces that faithfully translate complex Figma designs into production code.
Architect scalable backend systems with NestJS, Node.js and .NET Core: modular, clean-architecture APIs across REST, GraphQL and gRPC.
Designed and implemented event-driven microservice architectures — RabbitMQ for reliable message queues and asynchronous document processing.
Model and optimise data layers with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis, applying caching strategies tuned for read-heavy production traffic.
Build and operate on AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS, Serverless) with Docker, and monitor production health with Datadog.
Drive performance and cost efficiency: server-side Google Tag Manager, bundle reduction and Core Web Vitals improvements on high-traffic pages.
Orchestrate headless CMS integrations (Prismic, Strapi, HubSpot) — complete content pipelines that let marketing ship campaigns without developer involvement.
Design and implement CRM and scheduling platform integrations (Chili Piper, Intercom, HubSpot) with reliable data flows.
Lead secure payment gateway integrations for Southeast Asian providers (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPAY, ChargeBee, Xendit).
Apply AI-assisted development day to day — AI coding agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent skills, and custom rules and prompts embedded into team workflows.
Host internal sharing sessions and mentor junior developers; author technical documentation, architecture diagrams and stakeholder presentations.

items.title: Designveloper - Software Development Company
items.subTitle: FULL STACK DEVELOPER
items.description:
- Building Lumin PDF for a New Zealand client — a SaaS PDF platform with 100M+ users — within a dedicated team of 100+ engineers organised into squads.
- In-App PDF Editor squad: build and maintain core editor features used daily — annotate, e-sign, edit text, OCR, merge/rotate and AI-powered document tools — a Next.js front end backed by NestJS services communicating over gRPC.
- Developer in charge of the PDF x Lumin Sign integration, creating signature fields on PDFs and handing off to Lumin Sign for signing. Positioned Lumin against DocuSign and helped win multiple deals worth an estimated $29,500.
- Rebuilt the layout and flow of PDF actions (merge, rotate, organize) and tailored them for a financial-services customer, supporting a deal worth ~$16,000.
- Contributed feature mapping and migration support for the move from a third-party PDF engine to Lumin's in-house PDF SDK — an initiative estimated to save the client ~$5M.
- Core contributor to the "AI Migration", the largest campaign in Designveloper's history, delivered in 2 weeks: consolidated per-team repos into a single codebase, moved Gatsby to full Next.js, Bitbucket to GitHub, Jira/Confluence to Linear/Notion, and embedded AI tooling into the workflow. A feature previously estimated at ~1 year to ship was delivered in 2 weeks afterwards.
- Growth & Landing Page squad: built and maintained high-performance, SEO-driven landing pages with Gatsby, Next.js and React; tool pages (Merge, Split, Compress, Annotate) contributed to 100K+ signups in a single month.
- Shipped the PDF Localization feature — country-specific PDF content in the library — growing clicks from 15.9K (Jan-May 2024) to 36.8K (May-Dec 2024).
- Led the migration from Next.js Page Router to App Router with Server Components, and moved the backend from Next.js API routes to NestJS for scalability.
- Integrated Prismic, HubSpot and Strapi so marketing could launch campaigns and static pages without developer involvement.
- Migrated Google Tag Manager to server-side, cutting client-side JavaScript and improving landing-page performance by 2-4%.
- Developed PDF template pages that ranked in the top 10 of Google search results.
- Host and speaker at internal sharing, workshop and innovation sessions, presented in English to teammates and the client — received the "Sharing Spark Award" for outstanding knowledge sharing.
- Mentor in the company mentorship program; directly supervised an intern who passed the internship and now works full-time on Lumin.

items.title: Saigon MIO Technology JSC
items.subTitle: FULL STACK DEVELOPER

- Full-time at a fast-paced agency delivering MVPs and demo products for multiple clients.

- Integrated and synchronised payment gateways: MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPAY, ChargeBee and Xendit.
- Built pixel-accurate UI from Figma designs using Next.js, React and MUI.
- Member of the R&D team researching and integrating emerging technologies, including AI-driven features, into internal systems.
- Led Next.js knowledge-sharing sessions that shaped the frontend stack for later projects.

- Worked closely with the design team to keep the learning experience consistent across devices.
